subject: Invoice 2026-887 — funding cutover window & VAT handling
messages:
From: Marta Sánchez <marta.sanchez@lumencore.es>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@lumencore.es>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice 2026-887 — funding cutover window & VAT handling

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — things looked good on our side. Our AP team received invoice INV-2026-887 this morning (attached) and asked for two clarifications so we can schedule the wire/ACH: 1) Which entity should we remit to for VAT purposes? Lumencore is EU-registered and we need the correct tax ID on the payment remittance. 2) We have a planned funding cutover this Friday (24:00 CET) — can Redwood confirm the latest cutoff to guarantee same-day credit so we can plan the wire?

I've attached the invoice we received. If ACH is acceptable, we can send an ACH authorization — our AP prefers ACH but will do a wire if timing requires it.

Best,
Marta Sánchez
Finance Operations
Lumencore S.A.

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sánchez <marta.sanchez@lumencore.es>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-887 — funding cutover window & VAT handling

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. Quick answers: 1) Please remit to Redwood Inference, Redwood EU Ops Ltd (VAT ID: GB123456789). For VAT purposes in Spain you'll want our EU entity details — I attached a brief tax stub with the exact billing entity line you can drop on the remittance. Kimberly (cc) handles cross-border tax evidence; I'll let her confirm if any additional docs are required.

2) Cutoff: for same-day credit to our EU bank, we need the wire initiated by 17:00 CET on Friday (that corresponds to 08:00 PDT our side). If your AP can't hit that window, ACH initiated the same day often posts next-business-day but we can accept ACH if you can provide an authorization form.

Action items:
- Marta/AP: send ACH_authorization_form.pdf if you prefer ACH; otherwise confirm wire by 17:00 CET Friday.
- Kimberly: please confirm whether a VAT certificate or additional documentation is required for Lumencore to claim input VAT.

I'll also open a short HubSpot ticket to track the remittance so our billing team can reconcile once funds land.

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_eu_tax_stub.txt

From: Marta Sánchez <marta.sanchez@lumencore.es>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@lumencore.es>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:40:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-887 — funding cutover window & VAT handling

Hi David,

Thanks — we'll proceed with ACH. I've completed our side of the ACH_authorization_form.pdf (attached) and AP will route it for signature today. Two quick clarifications from AP: 1) On the remittance line, should we include the invoice number plus your EU VAT ID? 2) If ACH posts next business day and misses the Friday cutover, will Redwood apply any late fee or will the invoice be considered on-time for contract purposes given the bank transit?

I've attached the completed form and flagged the payment for priority processing.

Regards,
Marta

Attachments: ACH_authorization_form.pdf (stub), Lumencore_INV-2026-887.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sánchez <marta.sanchez@lumencore.es>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-887 — funding cutover window & VAT handling

Marta — perfect, thanks for sending the form. To answer AP's two points:

1) Please include the invoice number and our EU VAT ID on the remittance (example remittance line: "INV-2026-887 / Redwood EU Ops Ltd / VAT GB123456789"). That makes reconciliation immediate on our side.

2) We will not apply late fees for bank transit as long as the ACH authorization is received and dated today and your AP booked the transfer today. We treat receipt date as the date AP initiated the payment for reconciliation, provided the ACH authorization is included. If the transfer actually posts after the cutoff because of bank delays we'll handle it as good-faith and not escalate.

Next steps:
- I will create a short reconciliation ticket and link the DocuSign envelope once Kimberly confirms the VAT evidence preference.
- Irene (cc) will watch for the incoming funds and will mark the invoice as paid in our billing system when posted.

Thanks again — I'll confirm when funds are applied.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
